solved_invariants: Replaced 695,681 exhaustive cash baskets with 2,461: all 161 scalar singletons plus pair/triple combinations over a deterministic 24-offer frontier.
Refreshed the durable graph with 208 observed-offer nodes and 17 quantity-promotion nodes; basket projection retains all 208 source-condition entries and all 17 quantity laws.
CLI now supports graph-only refreshes, avoiding an unnecessary basket replay when only the durable graph is requested.
Architecture atlas export and validation pass.
body.summary: Implemented and exercised bounded FoodCombinationGraph replay for expanded store-ad inputs. Durable outputs retain all 208 offers and source-bound quantity laws while eliminating cubic scalar-basket growth.
